author: shaamad
text:
First off, thank you to everyone who came out to our first meeting. It really means a lot!
we're building something real here and it starts with you showing up.

Here's everything coming up:

📅 Thursday | 5–7 PM | CM22 Room 125

Two industry guests joining us this week:

5–6 PM — Carl Froggett, CISO/CIO at Deep Instinct and former CISO at Citi, is coming in to talk career trends, job insights, and 30+ years in the field. This one is not one to miss.

6–7 PM — Rooke Young from Arete Advisors walks us through the blue team side of the industry with some insight on recent threats.

I'll be dropping the Zoom link in Discord before the meeting — stay tuned.

🔧 Cyber Lab | Starting Today (Thursdays) at 10 AM | CM22 Room 150

We're starting work on the cyber lab tomorrow morning. Goal is to have it done by October. We'll be working on it every Thursday — if you want to help out before the meeting starts, ping me in Discord and I'll get you added.

🏆 SFISSA Hack-The-Flag | Sept 18–19

SFISSA sent over our codes. Use these at checkout on https://www.sfissahtf.com:

FAU Students/Faculty/Staff: FAUHTF26 (free admission + helps track FAU attendance)
SFISSA Members: SFISSAAGENTS26 (free admission)
Returning CTF contestants from last year: HTF26CTFPlayers25 (100% off)

Want to volunteer or represent the club at a village?

🙋 Volunteer Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSei-RDtxQ-Av6f5DQpZaMRcO586Rpdho_R3tpyZsEtC8M9xhw/viewform
🏕️ Club Village Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdPXRz0UIj_8PqnYvJ9LkrZtch3wSpCS1Suaa8Cg1XKVUfL7g/viewform

📚 Resources

Two things I highly recommend if you're trying to get into cyber or prep for competitions:

UCI Irvine Cyber Bootcamp (free, highly recommend): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vxvuqwHb7-5-OxNGUOANXyeEsf_eM2zd
CyPat competition prep guide: https://cypat.guide
Security+ Practice Quiz (SY0-701): https://secquizmaster.pythonanywhere.com/sec
Google Cybersecurity Certificate (free via FAU): https://www.coursera.org/programs/florida-atlantic-uni-google-learning-program-aacys

author: shaamad
text:
welcome back to the FAU Cybersecurity Club! 🦉💻

We're kicking off the semester strong and have a packed first week lined up. Whether you're brand new or coming back, this is the week to show up.

📅 Tuesday, September 1 | 5–7 PM | CM22 Room 125
Our first general meeting! We'll be covering who we are, what we've accomplished, what's coming this semester, labs, and most importantly — job opportunities we have lined up for members. Come ready to get plugged in.

📅 Thursday, September 3 | 5–7 PM | CM22 Room 125
We're going deep on cybersecurity careers — what roles exist, what skills they require, what they pay, and how to figure out what path is right for you.

At 6 PM we'll have a special guest — Rooke from Arete Advisors — coming in to walk us through the blue team side of the industry. You do not want to miss this.

All skill levels welcome. No experience needed to show up.
🔗 https://linktr.ee/faucyberclub

Drop a 🦉 if you're coming!

Meeting Location will be in the Channel and our Zoom link for meetings will be in our linktree!
